headline: Best captain picker in all of FPL: Abrams George,165 captain pts
body: The current best captain picker in all of FPL: 🥇 Abrams George 165 captain pts, captained Semenyo twice! The data gathering was not complete yet when we announced the manager with 157 pts as the top picker last week.   submitted by   /u/godfatherofweb [link]   [comments]
